runSummary.stalePolicy: LIVE eligibility requires real source verification and link evidence. Content age and source-verification age are separate; touching updatedAt alone never makes a job fresh.
runSummary.note: Fresh 13.9.2026 04:12 public-web sweep across 12 actually searched source families. No new unique promotion-grade job passed ranking, language, trust/economics and locality gates; jobs-data.json therefore stays fail-closed at 52 LIVE items. The strongest fresh freelance result was Upwork Customer Support and Virtual Assistant at 15–25 USD/h, worldwide remote and part-time, but the client account was created 2.9.2026 with no established spend/hire history visible and the role has mandatory email/customer communication, so it remains verification-only rather than LIVE. Upwork WordPress Content Automation & Blog QA VA is remote and training is offered, but explicitly requires strong written English; Shopify/VA and several support listings had implausibly low fixed budgets. Reddit public results were dominated by FOR HIRE self-promotion or US-only hiring. Facebook public indexing yielded 0 concrete verifiable hiring posts with direct links.

developmentChanges.title: Freelance application-window decay score
developmentChanges.reason: For freelance gigs, rank freshness using posted age together with proposal count, last-viewed activity, interviewing and hires. A technically good listing should fall quickly when it is already saturated or stale, while a newly posted low-competition gig gets reaction priority.

developmentChanges.title: Language evidence confidence
developmentChanges.reason: Store whether an English requirement is explicit, inferred from channel duties, or unknown. Explicit B2/C1 remains a strong penalty, while unproven language assumptions lower confidence instead of causing a false hard reject; this improves recall without hiding the A2 risk.
